app_info.subtitle: Run deterministic workflows
app_info.description: BOS is a platform for deterministic automated workflows across an agentic mesh of federated services. Its installed skills recognize multi-step objectives that may need an ad hoc dynamic workflow and use live application descriptions and discovered operations to assess composition. When the required authoring and runtime contracts are available, BOS Operations Center composes the workflow and BOS runs it under BOS-owned state, transitions, recovery, and evidence. It is the required foundation for dependent products and owns the authenticated BOS platform MCP connection. Live identity-context discovery supports server-authorized organization, application, installation, and role selection per operation; legacy scoped grants retain their exact boundaries. BOS coordinates authorized platform operations with server-enforced scope, evidence, and approvals.

test_cases.description: Resolve the authorized reviewer context and discovered platform capabilities.
test_cases.user_prompt: For my connected authorized review organization, show the organization, role, and BOS capabilities available for governed workflows.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the connected authorized review organization and effective role, with capabilities attributed to current discovered contracts; exposes no opaque authority identifiers or credentials.

test_cases.description: Audit currently available applications and service prerequisites.
test_cases.user_prompt: For my connected authorized review organization, audit the available apps and services. Show their reported readiness and any authorization or configuration prerequisites.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the actual discovered apps and services with source-backed readiness and prerequisites, preserves empty states, and invents no configured service.

test_cases.description: Inspect current search contracts and source availability.
test_cases.user_prompt: For my connected authorized review organization, describe CRM record search inputs, returned fields, source availability, limits, and error outcomes.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses actual returned Describe contracts to explain search inputs, outputs, source readiness, limits and errors with exact contract evidence.

test_cases.description: Assess bounded mutation effects without changing records.
test_cases.user_prompt: For my connected authorized review organization, compare the CRM record create and update contracts. Explain required and writable fields, target limits, effects, and approval requirements without changing any records.
test_cases.expected_output: Compares actual returned create/update schemas, effects and bounds, distinguishes advertised requirements from absent requirements, and performs no mutation.

test_cases.user_prompt: For my connected authorized review organization, assess whether the discovered contracts support composing and running a multi-step workflow. Show available capabilities, prerequisites, and any missing authoring or runtime contract.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses actual application/service/API descriptions to assess composition, identifies supported authoring/runtime capabilities or their exact absence, and invents no execution or completion.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger BOS for a general weather request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What will the weather be tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request does not involve BOS applications, settings, connections, or business workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger BOS for an unrelated creative-writing request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a four-line poem about autumn leaves.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Answer the creative-writing request without invoking BOS applications, settings, connections, or business workflows.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Disable every plugin belonging to an organization that I do not belong to.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should perform no mutation or disclosure and should explain that cross-tenant operations require authorized organization scope and an explicit bounded target.
